key_insight: φ-PICT enables sample-efficient gradient-based control of magnetoconvective flows, improving heat transfer by more than 25%.
engineering_relevance: Differentiable MHD simulation could support flow-control design for fusion blanket cooling, where efficient heat transfer is critical.
method: Develop a differentiable, GPU-accelerated MHD solver.
Integrate φ-PICT into FluidGym for active flow control.
Use simulation gradients for control optimization and inverse design.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports MHD benchmark validation, heat-transfer gains above 25%, and 10³× higher inverse-design accuracy than black-box methods.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish whether these gains generalize to reactor-relevant conditions or practical actuator constraints.
paper_title: Sample-Efficient Control of Magnetoconvective Flows via Differentiable Simulation
